description: Header file defining the ServiceManager class, which manages Android services, callbacks, and service lifecycle operations.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service with associated binder, permissions, priorities, and client info.

classes.name: ServiceManager
classes.description: Manages Android services, including registration, lookup, callbacks, and lifecycle.

methods.name: ServiceManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing ServiceManager with access control.

methods.name: ~ServiceManager
methods.description: Destructor for ServiceManager.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves or starts a service by name.

methods.name: checkService
methods.description: Checks if a service exists.

methods.name: addService
methods.description: Adds a new service with specified parameters.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Lists all available services.

methods.name: registerForNotifications
methods.description: Registers a callback for service notifications.

methods.name: unregisterForNotifications
methods.description: Unregisters a callback from service notifications.

methods.name: isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a service is declared.

methods.name: getDeclaredInstances
methods.description: Retrieves instances of a declared interface.

methods.name: updatableViaApex
methods.description: Checks if a service is updatable via APEX.

methods.name: getUpdatableNames
methods.description: Gets names of updatable services within an APEX.

methods.name: getConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection info for a service.

methods.name: registerClientCallback
methods.description: Registers a client callback for a service.

methods.name: tryUnregisterService
methods.description: Attempts to unregister a service.

methods.name: getServiceDebugInfo
methods.description: Retrieves debug info for services.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles binder death notifications.

methods.name: handleClientCallbacks
methods.description: Processes client callback notifications.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears service and callback state for debugging.

methods.name: tryStartService
methods.description: Attempts to start a service if not found.
